note: Phase 7 Lighthouse runs. Mobile emulation (Lighthouse's default form factor), Chrome 141 headless, simulated throttling, signed in as the e2e navigator through a session cookie in --extra-headers, against `pnpm start` on the production build at http://localhost:3000. The gate (locked plan section 8, Phase 7) is performance and accessibility >= 90 on the Board and the Case editor.
fixed: landmark-one-main: the case editor had no <main>. /cases/* sits outside the (app) shell, which has its own. Accessibility 98 -> 100.

inspector-issues (CSP kEvalViolation): zod 4 probes for its JIT compiler with Function("") inside a try/catch the first time a schema is used, and the Phase 7 CSP has no 'unsafe-eval'. `z.config({ jitless: true })` in src/lib/domain/validation.ts removes the probe. Best practices 96 -> 100.

layout-shifts / cumulative-layout-shift on the board: the new install banner rendered above the rows only after hydration, pushing every patient row down (CLS 0.121). Moved below the list, where it displaces nothing. Board performance 94 -> 98, CLS 0.121 -> 0.
label-content-name-mismatch on the board: the install banner's "Not now" button had an aria-label that did not contain its visible text (WCAG 2.5.3).
Screen-reader text for every elapsed clock: spokenHours() says "6 hours 5 minutes" where the tabular text reads "6h 05m", which a reader pronounces "six h zero five m".
One visible focus ring for every link, button and chip, stated once in app/globals.css rather than per component.

not-fixed.unused-javascript (94 KiB on the case ed: The React/Next runtime plus zod in the first client chunk. Splitting the editor's validation out is a design change, not a hardening change, and performance is already 96 against a gate of 90. Recorded for a later phase.
not-fixed.legacy-javascript-insight (13 KiB): Next's own polyfills, chosen by the default browserslist. Narrowing the browser target would drop support for whatever the hospital's older devices run; not a call to make silently in a hardening pass.
not-fixed.render-blocking-insight (30-70 ms): The single Tailwind stylesheet. Next's experimental inlineCss would remove it; experimental, applies to every page, and worth 50 ms against a passing score.
not-fixed.bf-cache: Every page sets Cache-Control: no-store, which is deliberate: a clinical board must never be restored from the back/forward cache with stale rows. Lighthouse itself marks both failure reasons "Not actionable".
not-fixed.seo 63 / is-crawlable / llms-txt: The app sets robots noindex on purpose (locked plan: a hospital tool behind a login). SEO is not a Phase 7 gate.
not-fixed.forced-reflow-insight, network-dependenc: Lighthouse 13 insights outside the plan's gate; none names a change this app controls.
